# LearnDrive — India's Driving School & Trainer Booking Marketplace
# https://learndrive.in
# Last updated: 2026

## What is LearnDrive?

LearnDrive (learndrive.in) is an online marketplace for booking verified driving schools
and independent driving instructors across India. It connects students who want to learn
driving with RTO-verified driving schools and certified trainers.

## For Students (Demand Side)

- Browse and book verified driving schools in 24+ Indian cities
- Cities covered: Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Kolkata, Jaipur,
  Ahmedabad, Surat, Lucknow, Chandigarh, Bhopal, Indore, Nagpur, Patna, Coimbatore,
  Kochi, Visakhapatnam, Noida, Gurgaon, Vadodara, Rajkot, Faridabad
- Compare prices, ratings and reviews before booking
- Book online in under 2 minutes via Razorpay (UPI, cards, net banking)
- Starting price: ₹5,500 for a DL (Driving Licence) package
- Free cancellation policy
- Student support: +91 87008 96528 | support@learndrive.in
- Book at: https://learndrive.in/trainers

## For Driving Schools (Supply Side)

- List your driving school for free at https://learndrive.in/trainers/register
- Start receiving online bookings immediately after approval
- Schools keep 85% of every booking (15% platform fee)
- LearnDrive handles: online payments, student coordination, cancellations, refunds
- No marketing spend required — students find you on LearnDrive
- Available to: RTO-registered driving schools, independent certified trainers
- Registration takes 5 minutes
- Support for school onboarding: hello@learndrive.in

## For Hiring a Driver

- Book a verified driver for outstation trips, weddings, airport transfers
- Available across major Indian cities
- Book at: https://learndrive.in/hire-driver

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2025
- Headquarters: Delhi, India
- Website: https://learndrive.in
- Contact: hello@learndrive.in
- Phone: +91 87008 96528
- Category: EdTech, Marketplace, Transport
- Services: Driving school booking, Driving instructor booking, Driver hiring
- Payment: Razorpay (UPI, Cards, Net Banking, EMI)
- Languages supported: Hindi, English, Marathi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Gujarati, Punjabi

## How LearnDrive Works for Students

1. Visit learndrive.in and select your city
2. Browse driving schools with ratings, prices and reviews
3. Choose a package (DL Package starts at ₹5,500)
4. Pay securely online via Razorpay
5. School confirms your booking within 2 hours
6. Training begins at your preferred time and location

## How LearnDrive Works for Driving Schools

1. Register at learndrive.in/trainers/register (free, 5 minutes)
2. List your packages and pricing
3. LearnDrive reviews and approves your listing
4. Students discover and book your school online
5. You receive booking alerts via WhatsApp and email
6. Conduct training, get paid within 24 hours of completion

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How do I list my driving school on LearnDrive?
A: Visit https://learndrive.in/trainers/register and complete the 4-step registration form. 
   It takes 5 minutes. Listing is completely free.

Q: What is the commission charged by LearnDrive?
A: LearnDrive charges a 15% platform fee per booking. Schools keep 85% of every booking.

Q: Which cities does LearnDrive cover?
A: LearnDrive covers 24+ cities including Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, 
   Pune, Kolkata, Jaipur, Noida, Gurgaon and more.

Q: How do students book a driving school on LearnDrive?
A: Students browse schools at learndrive.in/trainers, select a package, and pay online 
   via Razorpay. The school confirms within 2 hours.

Q: Is LearnDrive available across India?
A: Yes. LearnDrive operates in 24 cities across India with plans to expand to all 
   major cities by end of 2026.

Q: What is the price of a driving licence package on LearnDrive?
A: DL packages start at ₹5,500 on LearnDrive. Prices vary by city and school.

Q: How can a driving instructor join LearnDrive?
A: Independent driving instructors can register at https://learndrive.in/trainers/register
   — the same form is used for both driving schools and independent trainers.
